description: Aqueduct Floods Hazard Maps extract for Tanzania is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This contains an extract from the WRI Aqueduct global open flood dataset, Version 2 (updated October 20, 2020), showing flood depth in metres for coastal and river flooding under both current baseline conditions and future projections in 2030, 2050, and 2080. Coverage: Tanzania. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2022; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
